items.author: msvugraduate.bsky.social
items.context: First video game. Pong. Does that even count?
items.text: It counts for sure. Pong was a first for a lot of people, and it still shows how far simple rules can go.

items.author: nessachan.bsky.social
items.context: I can't remember the first video game I played because I have been playing them my whole conscious life. We had a huge arcade in town called Space Port and also an Aladdin's Castle. I had to stand on a milk crate. I remember Frogger, Ms. Pac-Man and Q-Bert.
items.text: The milk crate detail is perfect. Frogger, Ms. Pac-Man and Q*bert is a great arcade trio to grow up on.
